summary: Implemented T04 first timed event resource: calendar PROPFIND now lazily creates stable (uid, resource_name) mappings for existing timed non-recurring events so they appear in Apple; GET returns a valid canonical VCALENDAR, HEAD matches GET headers (fixed Content-Length), 404s return empty bodies, and ETag is a sha256 of canonical content that changes only with content. Added a lazy-mapping regression test and fixed the TestDb fixture (missing events/caldav_event_resources tables) which also un-broke 3 pre-existing T03 calendar tests.
defects: dav_event_resource recurring check uses unwrap_or(false), swallowing DB errors (fail-open); pre-existing, left as-is
follow_up: dav_calendar creates resource mappings during PROPFIND (a write side-effect on read) and issues N+1 queries per event; acceptable for T04 but a performance/limit concern for T18
important_context: Resource mapping (caldav_event_resources row) is created lazily on first exposure (calendar listing or GET) and is the stable uid/resource_name per event.
ETag = quoted sha256 hex of the canonical serialized VCALENDAR; deterministic for unchanged content.
Exposure is limited to timed, non-recurring events; all-day and recurring events are excluded per T04 scope.
TestDb fixture in backend/src/caldav/http.rs now includes events and caldav_event_resources tables, required for dav_calendar to run in unit tests.
